name: Same Komon
description: A fine sharkskin texture: tiny dots strung along overlapping fans of arcs, so the cloth seems to shimmer from a distance.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -50%; top: 0; width: 200%; height: 200%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); -webkit-mask: @var(--spokes), radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 0 52%, #000 52% 58%, transparent 58% 67%, #000 67% 73%, transparent 73% 82%, #000 82% 88%, transparent 88% 94%, #000 94% 100%, transparent 100%); mask: @var(--spokes), radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 0 52%, #000 52% 58%, transparent 58% 67%, #000 67% 73%, transparent 73% 82%, #000 82% 88%, transparent 88% 94%, #000 94% 100%, transparent 100%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --spokes: conic-gradient(from -90deg, #000 0deg 4.091deg, transparent 4.091deg 8.182deg, #000 8.182deg 12.273deg, transparent 12.273deg 16.364deg, #000 16.364deg 20.455deg, transparent 20.455deg 24.545deg, #000 24.545deg 28.636deg, transparent 28.636deg 32.727deg, #000 32.727deg 36.818deg, transparent 36.818deg 40.909deg, #000 40.909deg 45deg, transparent 45deg 49.091deg, #000 49.091deg 53.182deg, transparent 53.182deg 57.273deg, #000 57.273deg 61.364deg, transparent 61.364deg 65.455deg, #000 65.455deg 69.545deg, transparent 69.545deg 73.636deg, #000 73.636deg 77.727deg, transparent 77.727deg 81.818deg, #000 81.818deg 85.909deg, transparent 85.909deg 90deg, #000 90deg 94.091deg, transparent 94.091deg 98.182deg, #000 98.182deg 102.273deg, transparent 102.273deg 106.364deg, #000 106.364deg 110.455deg, transparent 110.455deg 114.545deg, #000 114.545deg 118.636deg, transparent 118.636deg 122.727deg, #000 122.727deg 126.818deg, transparent 126.818deg 130.909deg, #000 130.909deg 135deg, transparent 135deg 139.091deg, #000 139.091deg 143.182deg, transparent 143.182deg 147.273deg, #000 147.273deg 151.364deg, transparent 151.364deg 155.455deg, #000 155.455deg 159.545deg, transparent 159.545deg 163.636deg, #000 163.636deg 167.727deg, transparent 167.727deg 171.818deg, #000 171.818deg 175.909deg, transparent 175.909deg 180deg, transparent 180deg 360deg); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
